stem:
Reyansh places a treasure on the number $36$ on a number strip. He may jump by a fixed whole-number size from $0$ and wants every landing to hit $36$ exactly.

Which two claims are correct?

options.text: The answer is $36$, because that is the treasure number itself.
Jump size $9$ lands exactly on $36$, because $9$ divides $36$.
Jump size $36$ is forced, because $36$ is the largest printed mark on the strip.

teacher.key_rationale: A jump size works exactly when it is a divisor of 36. Nine divides 36, and the full divisor list is the set in C. Naming the treasure itself or forcing the largest mark alone misses the divisor test.
